features: Shared single theme/language controls on admin, customer and representative login; local Peyda Persian fonts at verified weights 400/500/600/700/800/900; retain local Inter for English.
Common customer, wallet, support and representative header; four-section floating account/renew/download/support dock; representative management links retained in account menu.

Native adaptation of supplied live notification feed for admin and customer, with actual read state, unread count, metadata, new-arrival animation and server-backed read-all/clear; no demo events or simulated progress.

Remove conflicting material specificity and mobile blur suppression; CSS blur available immediately, inline refraction map with optional enhancement only after successful decode; readable notification surfaces.
Simple white/black customer and partner backgrounds with restrained 4% wash; bright complementary avatar colors; blue Telegram card and unified teal/mint control palette.

Collapsible secondary account profile sections, equal-height credential inputs and inside password eye; icon-only draft clear beside sharing and full-settings shortcut beside Edit; remove Account actions block.
Consistent real pending/success/error button states; native form pending and async disabled-state handling; retain real download byte progress and wallet renewal ledger behavior.
Constrain high-digit usage/device metrics and shared mobile header/dock layouts.

validation.rendered_pages: 44 admin/customer EN/FA page renders plus 16 representative page renders, DOM contract checks.
validation.notifications: Backend read/clear isolation and CSRF; Node runtime checks for safe text, actual pending/success/error transitions, high-water mark and empty state.
validation.material: CSS cascade checks at 390 and 1200 px, both themes, for readable notifications, blue Telegram and simple backgrounds; decode gating tested in Node.
validation.source: Python/Jinja/CSS/Bash and installer source checks; four Node runtime checks; rebuilt 44 local AJAX program pins; ZIP CRC and SHA256 manifest.

limitations: Real browser visual rendering, Safari GPU refraction behavior and actual VPS upgrade have not been verified in this environment.
